question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **Effort**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Effort **means the exertion of physical or mental power to accomplish something. (किसी कार्य को पूरा करने के लिए शारीरिक या मानसिक शक्ति का प्रयोग)
 
• Grammatically, "effort" is a noun and can be used in various contexts such as making an effort, putting in effort, etc.
 
 
• **For example**: *She put in a lot of effort to complete the project on time.*
 
 
 
• The sentence in the passage implies that his back muscles are working hard, contracting and relaxing, in order to generate the force needed to lift him into the air.
 
• The word "**effort**" emphasizes the action of his muscles and underscores the physical strain involved in achieving the ascent.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Affection**: A gentle feeling of fondness or liking towards someone or something. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु के प्रति स्नेह या पसंद की कोमल भावना)
 
• **Manipulation**: The act of manipulating or controlling something or someone in a skilful manner. (किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति को कुशल तरीके से हेरफेर या नियंत्रित करने की क्रिया)
 
• **Litigation**: The process of taking legal action in a court of law. (किसी न्यायालय में कानूनी कार्रवाई करने की प्रक्रिया)
